args.body: 17 cannot-evaluate, 18 out-of-scope. The law set was written about fish and the scope mechanism now correctly reports that none of it reaches a bacterium, naming the real lineage each time. A law base with nothing to say about most of life is a fact about the law base, not about the bacterium.
